purpose: Discover training-set booking behaviour segments without outcome labels.

preprocessing.missing_values: Median imputation inside the fitted pipeline; affects four missing Children values.
preprocessing.skew: log1p for LeadTime, TotalNights, PreviousCancellations, and PreviousBookingsNotCanceled.
preprocessing.scaling: StandardScaler on all eight model features before Euclidean K-Means.

algorithm.name: KMeans
algorithm.parameter_status: Initial untuned baseline; k=4 chosen a priori for a compact interpretable segmentation.

metrics.silhouette_sampling: Fixed random sample from all training rows, random_state=42.
